Iotalamates have also been given orally or rectally for imaging of the gastrointestinal tract. Iotalamic acid is usually available as solutions containing up to 66.8% of sodium iotalamate or up to 60% of meglumine iotala- mate. The dose and strength used vary according to the proce- dure and route. A mixture of the two salts has been given to min- imise adverse effects.
